sources.title: mgoin/GLM-5.2-speculator.dspark · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview A DSpark speculator model for the zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8 base model, enabling faster inference through speculative decoding. DSpark extends the DFlash parallel draft backbone with two lightweight heads: a Markov logit-bias head (low-rank intra-block token dependency) and a per-position confidence head (accept-rate prediction). Trained with the speculators library.
